from pathlib import Path
import re
for p in Path('/var/ossec/ruleset/rules').glob('*.xml'):
 text=p.read_text(errors='replace')
 for m in re.finditer(r'<rule\b[^>]*\bid="(?:60005|62100|62101|62123|62124|62125|62126|62152|63100|63103|63104|63108)".*?</rule>',text,re.S):
  print(str(p));print(m.group(0))
import subprocess
subprocess.run(['/var/ossec/bin/wazuh-control','info'],check=True)
